_meta.purpose: AthleteContext: the durable athlete profile the Brain reads — training goal, training level, population, and equipment profile. This shape lives today as StateSnapshot.profile (services/stateAssembly.js); this contract names and versions it. Read-only, pure; NOT yet wired. Phase 5e plumbs training_level / population / equipment_profile from their defined sources and closes finding H-07.
_meta.profile_goal_source: services/trainingKnowledge.js TRAINING_GOALS is the single owner of the canonical goal vocabulary; the validator loads its keys and never copies them. A contracts-integrity test guards the alignment.
_meta.population_note: population has no code consumer or authoritative enum yet (StateSnapshot.profile.population is always null). v1 accepts null or a non-empty string; the anticipated set is general / older_adult / youth / busy_parent / home_gym. Phase 5e's reader closes this into a fixed enum in a later schema_version.
_meta.equipment_profile_note: no durable source yet (per-request equipment arrives on the IntentEnvelope as constraint.equipment). v1 accepts null or a plain object; the shape is closed once a durable source exists.
